build_profile: GHC 9.8.2 -O2 library/probe, one capability; initial Core GC limit 1; propagation counters enabled
probe_source:
import Infera hiding (main, solveQuery)
import qualified Infera.Core.Run as Run
main = do
  loaded <- loadFile "examples/breadboard.nprolog"
  (program, _) <- either fail pure loaded
  mapM_ (probe program) ["comps rc Cs, nets Cs Ns, best Cs Ns Wired P Cost?", "comps div Cs, nets Cs Ns, best Cs Ns Wired P Cost?", "comps tri Cs, nets Cs Ns, best Cs Ns Wired P Cost?", "Cs = [c p0 r \"1k\" n0 n1 1 1, c p1 r \"1k\" n2 n3 2 2, c p2 r \"1k\" n4 n5 3 3], Wired = [], solve_min Cs Wired 1 16 P Cost?"]
  mine <- loadFile "examples/minesweeper.nprolog"
  (mines, _) <- either fail pure mine
  mapM_ (probe mines) ["once (minefield 16 16 50 [window 2 2 2] Grid)?", "once (minefield_seed 10 10 50 [window 2 2 2] 42 Grid)?"]
probe program text = do
  query <- either fail pure (parseQuery text)
  (why,first,stats) <- Run.runCoreWithPropagationStats 1 program query
  let drain count next = do
        step <- next
        case step of
          Run.Stop -> pure count
          Run.Yield (Found state) later -> length (showAnswer (projectAnswer query state)) `seq` drain (count+1) later
          Run.Yield _ _ -> fail "Unexpected non-answer search item"
          Run.Abandon why -> fail why
  count <- drain (0::Int) first
  counters <- stats
  print (text,why,count,counters)
query: comps rc Cs, nets Cs Ns, best Cs Ns Wired P Cost?
